title: Trust Graduation Posterior
description: Computed Beta posterior, tier, and graduation state for one action class. Trust Graduation Protocol v0.1, section 5.

protocol_version.description: Trust Graduation Protocol version this posterior conforms to.

action_class.description: Canonical action class identifier. Producers MUST canonicalize legacy identifiers (per protocol §2) before validating against this schema.

alpha.description: Beta distribution alpha parameter (positive evidence + prior).

beta.description: Beta distribution beta parameter (negative evidence + prior).

samples.description: Count of in-window evidence rows with non-zero weight (positive + negative).

positive.description: Count of in-window evidence rows with weight > 0.

negative.description: Count of in-window evidence rows with weight < 0.

neutral.description: Count of in-window evidence rows with weight = 0.

mean.description: Posterior mean approval rate: alpha / (alpha + beta).

ci_low.description: Lower bound of the 95% credible interval.

ci_high.description: Upper bound of the 95% credible interval.

ci_width.description: Width of the credible interval (ci_high - ci_low). Used as a precision indicator.

evidence_quality.description: Counts of evidence rows grouped by quality tier (per §4.2).

trust_violation_recent.description: True when at least one in-window evidence row (within 30 days) matches the trust-violation regex (§6.1).

tier.description: Current enforcement state for the action class.

graduation_ready.description: True when ci_low >= ci_low_min[action_class] AND samples >= samples_min[action_class] AND NOT trust_violation_recent. A recommendation surface only; does not itself grant autonomy.

by_source.description: Count of contributing evidence rows by source identifier. Useful for understanding which trackers fed the posterior.
